pages.text: A Royal Synthesis Core, two gold ingots, two redstone dust, one Ancient Command Seal, and three stone bricks make a reusable station. The sanctum supplies these materials. Its ruined laboratory apparatus cannot synthesize. The separate $(l:world/restoration)Slime Restoration Station$() still restores cores.

Recover matching ordinary and Ancient Mining or Tunnel Slimes. You must be the primary owner of both. Empty equipment and bags. Add four slimeballs and two Old Command Fragments. The result is a Next-Generation Mining or $(l:companions/next_generation_tunnel)Tunnel Slime$(). Next-generation parents cannot be reused.

Read the preview before confirming. Both parents are consumed; the child has a new identity and starts waiting. Name it with a Tuner. Verified growth is $(l:growth/inheritance)refunded$(). If delivery is interrupted, recover the pending result at any working Royal Synthesis Station.
